# shadcn-angular

> Copy-paste Angular component library. The CLI writes real source files into
> your project — there is no runtime package to depend on, so every component
> below is code you own and can edit.

## How to use this file

Every component section states the exact install command, the exact import, the
element selector, the full input/output surface with declared types, and a usage
snippet that compiles. Prefer these facts over anything you remember about
shadcn/ui for React: this is Angular, the selectors are `ui-*` elements, and
the APIs are Angular signal inputs, not React props.

Rules that hold for every component:

- Install with `npx @gilav21/shadcn-angular@latest add <name>` before importing it. The
  command also installs the component's dependency closure.
- Components are standalone. Import the class and list it in the consuming
  component's `imports: []` array. There is no NgModule.
- The import path shown is the default alias from `components.json`
  (`@/components/ui`). If a project configured a different `ui` alias, substitute it.
- Inputs are signal inputs. Bind them from a template exactly like any other
  Angular input; read them in TypeScript as `comp.value()`.
- Inputs marked `(required)` must be bound or the template will not compile.
- A section without a snippet says so explicitly; do not invent one.

## Index (172 components)

- [accordion](#accordion): Vertically stacked, collapsible sections that expand one or more panels to reveal content.
- [alert](#alert): Inline callout banner for important messages with title, description, and variants.
- [alert-dialog](#alert-dialog): Modal dialog that interrupts the user to confirm or cancel a destructive action.
- [area-chart](#area-chart): Area chart with optional stacking (absolute or percent), smoothing curves, crosshair, and an interactive legend.
- [aspect-ratio](#aspect-ratio): Wrapper that constrains its content to a fixed width-to-height ratio (e.g. 16:9).
- [autocomplete](#autocomplete): Text input with a filtered suggestion dropdown and highlighted matches as you type.
- [avatar](#avatar): User profile image with automatic fallback to initials or a placeholder.
- [badge](#badge): Small label for statuses, counts, or tags with color variants.
- [banner](#banner): Persistent page-level announcement bar with severity variants and an optional dismiss control.
- [bar-chart](#bar-chart): Bar chart comparing categorical values with horizontal or vertical bars.
- [bar-chart-drilldown](#bar-chart-drilldown): Interactive bar chart whose bars drill down into nested detail charts.
- [bar-race-chart](#bar-race-chart): Animated racing bar chart showing ranked values changing over time.
- [bento-grid](#bento-grid): Responsive bento-style grid of variable-size cells for feature showcases.
- [blur-fade](#blur-fade): Reveals content with a combined blur and fade-in entrance animation.
- [boxplot](#boxplot): Quartile summary per group: box, median, 1.5xIQR whiskers and outlier points, from raw values or pre-computed stats.
- [breadcrumb](#breadcrumb): Hierarchy trail showing the current page location with links to ancestor pages.
- [bubble-chart](#bubble-chart): Scatter plot with a third dimension encoded as area-proportional bubble size.
- [bullet-chart](#bullet-chart): Compact linear KPI bar with qualitative range bands and a target marker.
- [button](#button): Clickable button with variants (default, destructive, outline, ghost, link) and sizes.
- [button-group](#button-group): Joins related buttons into a single segmented control with shared borders.
- [calendar](#calendar): Month-grid date calendar for selecting single dates with localized weekdays.

- [candlestick](#candlestick): OHLC price chart with bodies and high/low wicks, on an ordinal axis that closes weekend gaps or a continuous time axis.
- [card](#card): Container with header, content, and footer slots for grouping related information.
- [card-accordion](#card-accordion): Collapsible sections styled as elevated cards, with a header, optional actions, and a smooth height animation.

- [toast](#toast): Transient notification messages that stack and auto-dismiss from a corner.
- [toggle](#toggle): Two-state toggle button that can be pressed on or off.
- [toggle-group](#toggle-group): Group of toggle buttons supporting single or multiple selection.
- [tooltip](#tooltip): Small floating label that explains an element on hover or focus.
- [tour](#tour): Guided product tour highlighting elements with step-by-step popovers.
- [tree](#tree): Hierarchical tree view with expandable nodes, icons, and labels.
- [tree-context-menu](#tree-context-menu): Directive wiring a context menu to tree nodes for per-node right-click actions.
- [tree-select](#tree-select): Dropdown select backed by a hierarchical tree for picking nested options.
- [treemap](#treemap): Hierarchical part-to-whole as nested area, squarified so rectangles stay near square and labels fit.
- [typing-animation](#typing-animation): Reveals text character by character with a blinking typewriter cursor.
- [virtual-scroll](#virtual-scroll): Renders only visible rows of large lists for high-performance scrolling.
- [waterfall-chart](#waterfall-chart): Waterfall chart of running totals with floating bars, connectors, and total columns.
- [wobble-card](#wobble-card): Card that wobbles and tilts in response to the pointer for a 3D feel.
- [word-rotate](#word-rotate): Cycles through a list of words in place with an animated transition.

## animation

### blur-fade

Reveals content with a combined blur and fade-in entrance animation.

- Install: `npx @gilav21/shadcn-angular@latest add blur-fade`
- Import: `import { BlurFadeComponent } from '@/components/ui/blur-fade';`
- Selector: `ui-blur-fade`
- Category: animation
- Depends on: none
- npm dependencies: none
- Inputs: `class: string = ''`, `delay: number = 0`, `direction: "up" | "down" | "left" | "right" = 'up'`, `duration: number = 500`, `inView: boolean = true`
- Outputs: `replay: void`

```html
<ui-blur-fade>Content</ui-blur-fade>
```

### comparison-slider

Before/after slider that wipes between two overlaid images via a handle.

- Install: `npx @gilav21/shadcn-angular@latest add comparison-slider`
- Import: `import { ComparisonSliderComponent } from '@/components/ui/comparison-slider';`
- Selector: `ui-comparison-slider`
- Category: animation
- Depends on: none
- npm dependencies: none
- Inputs: `afterAlt: string = ''`, `afterLabel: string`, `afterSrc: string` (required), `beforeAlt: string = ''`, `beforeLabel: string`, `beforeSrc: string` (required), `class: string = ''`, `locale: LocaleInput<ComparisonSliderLocale>`, `orientation: ComparisonSliderOrientation = 'horizontal'`, `position: number = 50`
- Outputs: `position: number`

```html
<ui-comparison-slider afterSrc="text" beforeSrc="text" />
```

- Category: animation
- Depends on: none
- npm dependencies: none
- Inputs: `manualTrigger: boolean = false`, `options: ConfettiOptions = {}`

```html
<div uiConfetti></div>
```

### stagger-children

Animates child elements into view one after another with a staggered delay.
